facts.fact: Dunning：主街五百码的商店酒吧餐馆，富人宅邸在高地俯瞰全镇。
facts.anchor: The rich staring down over everyone else.

facts.fact: 山上新建豪宅：圣诞新自行车侧倒在草坪、足球覆着霜——家庭生活的痕迹。
facts.anchor: a bike, new for Christmas, maybe, left on its side

facts.fact: 门口停了六辆车——「他们全在这儿」。
走廊墙上是一家四口照片——但这不是水槽里的女人；这是 April Gallagher 的家。
facts.anchor: a tall handsome husband; a beautiful dark-haired wife; two kids—son and daughter

facts.fact: Grant Walker（至少六英尺三）挡住走廊威逼 Alex。
facts.anchor: Tell me what the fuck’s going on. Right now.

facts.fact: Lacey 承认泄密：她对 Grant 说「有个杀手在逃」。
facts.anchor: I had to tell him something

facts.fact: Scott Cook 瘫坐在吧台凳上、眼神空茫——被噩耗击碎；Alex 后悔电话里说。
facts.anchor: hunched over the kitchen island, a wide and vacant look in his eye

facts.fact: Alex 推断：这群人的钱不是本地挣的——离开镇子发了财为什么回来？
facts.anchor: if they’d left town to make millions, why return to Dunning?

facts.fact: Alex 摊牌：妨碍州警调查就进监狱——在 Dunning 再重要也没用。
facts.anchor: obstructing a Washington State Police investigation

facts.fact: 章末三问：他们是谁？警长知道多少？为什么有人想杀他们？
